title: Retro Looks, Touchscreen Smarts: The Fujifilm instax mini Evo 2 Is Made For Outfit Shots And Nights Out - Harper's Bazaar Singapore

 The hybrid instant camera pairs a classic two-tone design with 100 effect combinations, a 4.5-inch touchscreen and smartphone printing
 Photos: Courtesy of Fujifilm By  Harper's BAZAAR Singapore  -  published 17 Nov 2026 
 Nostalgia never really goes out of style. As the Y2K revival continues, digital cameras are making a comeback, along with the gritty, flash-heavy photographs favoured by Gen Z. Instant photographs are finding their place as keepsakes again, too – a refreshing change when so many pictures never make it beyond a camera roll.
 Naturally, a camera with looks to match has a certain appeal. Enter the Fujifilm instax mini Evo 2, a hybrid instant camera whose stylish retro design comes with some decidedly modern technology, from 100 creative effect combinations to the ability to print your favourite smartphone photographs.

 What’s new about the Fujifilm instax mini Evo 2?
 Taking its cues from classic cameras, the Fujifilm instax mini Evo 2 comes complete with a two-tone silver-and-black body, tactile control dials and a print lever that gives you the satisfaction of producing an instant photograph yourself.
 Old-school charm meets modern technology in the Fujifilm instax mini Evo 2, which takes its design cues from vintage cameras.
 Photo: Courtesy of Fujifilm Measuring 87.5mm by 125.3mm by 43.7mm, the camera also features the first-ever 4.5-inch touchscreen in the instax series.
 The display lets you compose shots, adjust settings and browse photographs much as you would on your smartphone.
 There’s also the option to decide which pictures are worth printing, particularly useful when you’ve finally got everyone together for a group photo, only to realise someone had their eyes shut.
 Create your own mixtape at the instax launch event on Nov 21, 2026
 To celebrate the launch of the instax mini Evo 2, Fujifilm is collaborating with The Cassette Club for a special event on Nov 21. Participants can join a two-hour workshop to create their own mixtapes, from curating a playlist and recording voice messages to personalising their cassette cases.
 Each workshop booking includes a complimentary Fujifilm experience, featuring instax instant photo keepsakes and a Mini Bedazzle Bar. Sessions start from $89 per person, with limited slots available.
 Be among the first to experience the Fujifilm instax mini Evo 2 and register for the launch event here .

 100 ways to get creative with your photos
 For those with an eye for a good look, the Fujifilm instax mini Evo 2 offers 100 creative combinations by mixing and matching 10 Lens Effects with 10 Film Effects. Two physical dials make switching between them easy, with plenty of room to experiment.
 Light Leak recreates the streaks of light associated with old film photographs, while Vignette darkens the edges to draw attention to your subject. Half Frame is particularly fun for outfit-of-the-day photos, allowing you to pair a full-length shot with a close-up of your accessories.
 On the Film Effects side, Sepia lends images an old-fashioned warmth, while Retro recalls the colours of vintage photography. Monochrome gives them a timeless black-and-white finish; while Pale softens the overall tone of a photo. You can even combine the Lens and Film Effects to create your own combinations, depending on the occasion or your mood.
 With 10 Lens Effects and 10 Film Effects to mix and match, the Fujifilm instax mini Evo 2 offers 100 creative combinations to give your instant photographs a personal touch.
 Photo: Courtesy of Fujifilm A new way to frame and relive your memories
 Anyone who has tried squeezing a group of friends into a photograph, or fitting an entire landscape into the frame, will appreciate a little extra perspective. Fortunately, the Fujifilm instax mini Evo 2 knows its angles.
 The instax Expanded View function shows a wider area on screen than the final print will capture, making it easier to position your subject before pressing the shutter. It’s particularly useful when photographing moving subjects, giving you a better sense of when they’ll enter the frame so you don’t miss the moment.
 The Expanded View feature lets you see beyond the usual shooting frame, making it easier to anticipate when moving subjects will enter the shot.
 Photo: Courtesy of Fujifilm Then there’s instax Immersive Movie, a feature that records a five-second silent video, including the four seconds before you press the shutter. Think of it as preserving the little moments leading up to a photograph, whether it’s someone making the final adjustments to their outfit before stepping out or a friend bursting into spontaneous laughter during a night out.

 From your smartphone to an instant print
 The hybrid camera also doubles as a smartphone printer, allowing you to turn images from your camera roll into physical instant photographs.
 The dedicated instax mini Evo app also lets you transfer digital versions of photographs you’ve printed, along with their accompanying videos, and revisit previous prints through its Print History function.
 You can even use your phone as a remote shutter, which comes in handy for selfies or group photographs without leaving anyone out of the shot.
 The Fujifilm instax mini Evo 2, at $399, will be available at Fujifilm X Space (Suntec City, unit #02-486) and the Fujifilm online store from Nov 27, 2026.
